body:
Implements the adoption + messaging half of ADR-004 (docs/wiki/decisions/adr-004-roles-and-adoption.md). Blocked by the manual-reclaim fix — the framing sentence is dishonest until it lands.

1. docs/manual-mode.md: the day-one loop (init/doctor, create --blocked-by, list, claim -> export line, context as the brief, one terminal verb, comment as steering, promote as the by-hand lever, dispatch --max 0 to reconcile merged PRs), the heartbeat contract (heartbeat or be reclaimed after stale_after), serve as the human board view, and the agent-assisted migration recipe: paste roadmap.md, have your agent run hkb create per story. NO hkb import parser (see ADR-004 rejected alternatives).
2. README: insert the "Who runs a board: the seats" section between How-it-works and What-it-costs (final wording in ADR-004 / the evaluation report), folding in the bolded sentences at README.md:41/44; keep the autonomous quickstart first and add a "drive it by hand" subsection directly after, with: hand mode and autonomous mode are the same protocol with a different dispatcher - you, or the tick; and: every agent run leaves a summary the next run reads - even when you launch the agent yourself.
3. protocol.md: condensed 5-line seats version at the top.
title: Manual mode: docs/manual-mode.md, README seats section and hand-mode subsection
